title: MVP: dashboard/API blueprint instancing - Product Forge instance + one per generated project
body: The dashboard+API must be instantiable per target: the Product Forge instance (this build) and a per-project instance generated/provisioned for each project the pipeline creates. Shared component/API code (blueprint); per-instance data + config; role (operator/tenant) + build split respected. Delivered as part of the generated project. Depends on backend forge:dashboard-blueprint.
